description: Searches Refapp's help center (support.refapp.com) for articles on how to use Refapp, such as sending reminders to references, project settings or background checks. Returns the best matching articles with title, link, language and a short excerpt. When no article exists in the requested language, articles in other languages are returned.

language.description: Language of the question: sv, en, no (Norwegian) or da

query.description: A few keywords from the question, in the user's language
